The R9 Nano is an impressive card with serious power for its footprint. Unfortunately, the packaging that XFX is using for this card is the same they use for nearly every other card which doesn't accommodate the smaller size. My card was bouncing around in the box by the time it reached me because of the lack of packaging with a proper fit to hold and contain the smaller card. If you want to grab an R9 Nano I would recommend a different manufacturer.
